description: Builds a Vietnamese Tử Vi Đẩu Số (Purple Star) birth chart from Gregorian birth date, birth time and gender: lunar date, can chi, nạp âm, cục, the 12 palaces with their stars, and a short rule-based reading of each palace. Use when the user wants their Tử Vi chart or asks what their chart says.

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth in Vietnam time, HH:MM 24-hour. Use 12:00 if unknown and say so.

view_year.description: Gregorian year to read the yearly luck for; default is the current year

name: create_tuvi_chart
title: Create Tử Vi chart
